messages:
Olivia Grant: Post-publish update — we pushed the benchmark post live at 09:00 PT. Two quick items: 1) minor correction to the H1 (remove 'unbeatable'); 2) small discrepancy in the 50th pct number flagged by eng.
Samir Desai: Saw the edit. Nice catch on the H1. Can we do an inline correction note at top + tweet correction thread?
Hannah Park: Agree on transparency. Suggest a 2-line correction box at top: 'Correction: headline updated for precision. See method note for details.' Then tweet thread with link to methods.
Leo M.: Eng looked at the discrepancy — it's a CSV parsing quirk for sequences >1024. We're re-running that subset now (ETA 20m). Numbers look within margin but we should wait for re-run before calling it final.
PressOps Bot: Holding scheduled social sends for follow-ups. Draft correction tweet ready. Will queue once Olivia approves. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Olivia Grant: Ok — implement correction box and hold the larger social amplification until eng confirms. PressOps, prepare a short CEO thread in case outlets ask; keep tone factual.
Samir Desai: Draft CEO thread: 'We updated our benchmark headline to be more precise. Our team found a parsing edge-case and reran affected tests; full results and methods are linked. We prioritize accuracy.' Thoughts?
Hannah Park: Good. Legal: avoid words like 'mistake' or 'error' — prefer 'updated' or 'corrected'. Also include link to the methods repo.
metrics-bot: Alert: traffic spike + referral from Hacker News at 09:12 PT. Top referrers: hn.com, dev.to. Current pageviews 4.5k/min. (reaction :fire:)
Leo M.: Re-run finished. New 50th pct numbers are within 1% of original — no content-level change required, but we'll attach an appendix note documenting the fix and exact delta.
Olivia Grant: Great. Action items:
- Hannah: add correction box and appendix note (now)
- Samir: prep CEO thread but hold send until Olivia GO
- PressOps Bot: hold social amplification until GO (H +10m after Olivia)
- Leo/Eng: paste short technical note for appendix with exact delta and cause
Hannah Park: Correction box added and appendix updated: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-apx. Wording posted in the doc.
PressOps Bot: Social drafts updated to reference the appendix. Holding for Olivia GO.
Olivia Grant: Thanks everyone — GO for CEO thread and social amp at 09:25 PT. We'll post the correction note and link to methods. Keep monitoring for press questions and thread replies. :eyes:
